title: PPG-MS2 — PRISM Path Integration (constant-engagement adaptive spiral via PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine wiring)
description: Activates the existing 1242-LOC PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine (formerly SolidCAMiMachiningEngine, renamed in MS18/U-PPGM111) — PRISM's constant-engagement adaptive spiral implementation marketed as PRISM Path™ — by wiring it into the post pipeline, dispatcher action, and wizard. The engine is fully implemented but currently has zero callers; this milestone makes its constant-engagement adaptive toolpath available to every post that can emit it. Independent implementation of the constant-engagement morph-spiral concept; not derived from third-party patented algorithms.
rationale: The 10-post audit identified PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine (the 1242-LOC constant-engagement spiral engine renamed in MS18/U-PPGM111) as the single largest piece of dormant leverage in the codebase. It implements constant-engagement adaptive spiral toolpaths under the PRISM Path brand. We already paid the implementation cost; activating it costs ~5 units of wiring. Engine renamed (MS18/U-PPGM111 dependency) from SolidCAMiMachiningEngine to PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine; no internal SolidCAM identifiers remain after rename.
leverage_existing: PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine (1242 LOC, src/engines/PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine.ts; renamed in MS18/U-PPGM111 from internal SolidCAMiMachiningEngine.ts class symbol — file rename gated on MS18 sanitization) — morphed spiral, engagement controller, chip-thinning compensation
BlockByBlockFeedEngine (PPG-MS1) — feeds the per-block S/F that iMachining needs
InstantaneousEngagementEngine — independent verification of engagement targets
PostProcessorGeneratorPage — wizard slot for PRISM Path mode toggle

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: JM Die D2 die plate, 60×40×25 mm pocket roughing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms2: Adaptive clearing from Fusion HSM; respectable but engagement spikes to 88% in corners → forced to derate the whole op. PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine.morphSpiral() is sitting idle.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms2: Wizard shows 'PRISM Path mode' toggle (constant-engagement adaptive spiral). Toolpath emits as morphed spiral with engagement clamped to 35%; F+RPM ride the chatter envelope; cycle time wins 28% on D2 vs adaptive clearing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Existing engine is reachable, callable, and produces measurable wins on real customer parts.

units.title: Morphed-spiral parameter mapping
units.scope: Map wizard inputs (engagement target, chip-load target, axial DOC) to PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine.morphSpiral() parameters

units.title: Chip-thinning compensation pass
units.scope: Wire ChipThinningEngine onto morph-spiral output before post emit; verify gamma per insert geometry

units.title: Dispatcher action: cam_prism_path_morph_spiral
units.scope: camDispatcher.ts + camActionSchemas.ts (Zod) + lazy import; named cam_prism_path_morph_spiral (specific) to avoid ambiguity with existing imachining_compute / cam_solidcam_create_imachining family.

units.title: Wizard panel: PRISM Path mode + parameter overrides
Round-trip + cycle-time test (D2 pocket benchmark)
units.scope: src/__tests__/PrismPathIntegration.test.ts — assert engagement-clamped output, ≥20% cycle-time win vs the named adaptive baseline (recipe: jm_die_d2_pocket_v1 pinned to commit SHA stored in tests/baselines/d2-adaptive-baseline.json), executed against the same 50-program JM Die regression corpus referenced in PPG-MS1.

completion_criteria: PrismPathConstantEngagementEngine (renamed in MS18/U-PPGM111 from internal SolidCAMiMachiningEngine class) reachable via cam_prism_path_generate dispatcher action
Wizard exposes PRISM Path mode for any compatible operation (pocketing, slotting, profiling)
D2 reference benchmark: ≥20% cycle-time win vs the named adaptive baseline (jm_die_d2_pocket_v1 + commit SHA) on the PPG-MS1 50-program corpus, at equal-or-better surface and force ceilings
Zero engagement spikes >5% above target across the regression corpus
